# `Q-2-23` — Unclosed Inline Math

> An inline-math span opens with `$` but no closing `$` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Inline math (`$x^2 + y^2 = z^2$`) must be balanced inside the
same block. This error fires when an opening `$` has no matching
close.

## Why this happens

The most common cause is a literal `$` for a currency amount
being read as a math opener — for instance `$5 to $10` opens
math at the first dollar sign and runs until the next.

## How to fix

For currency, escape the dollar signs:

```markdown
The range is \$5 to \$10.
```

For real math, add the closing `$` at the intended end.

## Example

```markdown
$
```

## Related

- The display-math form `$$ ... $$` is parsed as a block, not
  inline; an unclosed display math reports differently.
